import io,json,contextlib,sys
from tests.scripts.backlog.review.public_probe import main
capture=io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(capture):main()
observed=json.loads(capture.getvalue())
expected={'# C#':'C#','# C# #':'C#','# Title #':'Title','# ##':''}
cases=[{'input':v['input'],'expected':expected[v['input']],'actual':v['observed_title'],'passed':v['observed_title']==expected[v['input']]} for v in observed['outputs']]
passed=all(v['passed'] for v in cases)
print(json.dumps({'public_contract':'Attached hashes are literal; separated terminal closing hashes are removed, including empty headings. Fixed public inputs only.','producer':observed['producer'],'cases':cases,'passed':passed}))
raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)
